title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Burglary Deductible on First Claim Decisions
content:
**Clause.** On a first decision on a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim, the deductible charged is taken from the deductible base of the decision. The deductible base is the level's deductible, except that for a burglary claim on a unit whose class has drive-up access it is 10 percent of the settled total, and for a burglary claim on a unit whose class has no drive-up access it is 5 percent of the settled total, in both burglary situations never less than the level's deductible.

The peril is read from the claim as filed; drive-up access is a feature of the unit class of the covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.

## Condition — base

| Peril on the claim | Unit class drive-up access | Deductible base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| burglary | yes | the higher of 10 percent of the settled total and the level's deductible |
| burglary | no | the higher of 5 percent of the settled total and the level's deductible |
| any other peril | either | the level's deductible |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Burglary, drive-up unit, settled total 4,000.00, level deductible 250.00: 10 percent is 400.00, which is above 250.00, so the base is 400.00.
- Burglary, interior unit, same figures: 5 percent is 200.00, below 250.00, so the base is 250.00.
- Fire, drive-up unit: the base is the level's deductible, 250.00.
